folder_layout: raw/<CLASS_NAME>/*.jpg  (one folder per class, mirroring FabricCategory)

collection_guidance.per_class_target: 300+ real photos before training; 1000+ before claiming accuracy numbers
collection_guidance.capture: fabric flat or draped, fills most of frame; vary lighting (daylight, market shade, indoor), distance (30cm-2m), angle, folds
collection_guidance.sources: market photography days (Makola, Kantamanto, Kejetia), weaver cooperatives (Bonwire kente, Tamale fugu), user-contributed photos with consent
collection_guidance.avoid: screens, prints of photos, watermarked stock, near-duplicate burst frames
collection_guidance.honesty: never mix authentic hand-woven and machine-printed samples in KENTE without labelling; consider a separate AUTHENTICITY task (see Authente-Kente)
